requirement.description: {model_monica} noted that the retraining trigger is not reviewed before execution. She would accept a manual retraining trigger if it is governed by the model team.
requirement.fact: {model_monica} noted that the retraining trigger is not reviewed before execution.
requirement.reading: She would accept a manual retraining trigger if it is governed by the model team.

speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: You framed my note as a demand for a new gate, but I am simply asking for the model team to sign off before we burn compute on a retrain. We need that review step to be visible in the workflow so we are not blamed for a bad trigger later.
output.correction: I never said we want to stop the automation or move to a fully manual process. I am only asking that the decision to retrain has a clear owner and a recorded approval before the job runs.
